password.description: Please enter your current password and choose a new secure password.
password.success: Password changed successfully! You will receive a confirmation email.

validation.min_length_error: Password must be at least 8 characters long
validation.uppercase_error: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter
validation.lowercase_error: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter
validation.number_error: Password must contain at least one number
validation.special_char_error: Password must contain at least one special character
validation.must_be_different: New password must be different from current password

delete_account.title: Deactivate Account
delete_account.warning: Warning: you will be signed out and lose access
delete_account.warning_permanent: Deactivating disables access to your account
delete_account.deactivation_notice: Your account will be deactivated immediately and you will be signed out. Your data is retained, not deleted. Contact support to reactivate your account, or to request that your data be erased.
delete_account.confirm_message: Deactivating your account signs you out and blocks sign-in until it is reactivated. Your bookings, messages and reviews are kept.
delete_account.ack_permanent: I will be signed out and unable to sign in again
delete_account.ack_data_loss: My data is retained, not deleted — erasure must be requested separately
delete_account.ack_active_bookings: Any bookings in progress stay as they are and may need settling with the other party
delete_account.ack_no_refund: Deactivating does not refund pending transactions
delete_account.type_to_confirm: Type DEACTIVATE MY ACCOUNT to confirm
delete_account.type_exactly: Please type exactly: DEACTIVATE MY ACCOUNT
delete_account.grace_period: Your data is retained after deactivation
delete_account.grace_period_description: Deactivating hides your account and blocks sign-in. It does not erase your data. To have your data deleted, contact support and ask for erasure.
delete_account.last_chance: This is your last chance to cancel. Once you click "Deactivate My Account", you will be signed out immediately.
delete_account.confirmation_verified: Confirmation text verified. You may proceed with deactivation.
delete_account.success: Your account has been deactivated and you have been signed out.

consequences.personal_data_detail: Profile information and settings are kept, not deleted
consequences.bookings_detail: Existing bookings are not cancelled and may need settling with the other party
consequences.reviews_detail: Reviews you wrote remain visible to others
consequences.messages_detail: Conversation history is retained and not deleted

privacy.visibility_private: Private (visible only to providers with an active booking)
privacy.visibility_desc: Controls who can find your profile when searching for service customers.
privacy.export_desc: Download a copy of all your account data including profile, bookings, and reviews in JSON format.
privacy.memory_desc: Control what the AI assistant remembers about your preferences and history.
privacy.delete_desc: Requesting account deletion will deactivate your account and schedule it for permanent deletion after 30 days.
privacy.delete_contact: To request deletion, use the Delete My Account button on the main Profile page.

messages.validation_error: Please check your information and try again
